summary: The main parses and forwards CLI n/s/i values, builds nItems CSR, and launches a grid-stride one-thread-per-row kernel. It includes one separate warmup and synchronization, then starts events around the requested host repetition loop, synchronizes the stop event and copies output. Compiled main preserves the loop count/backedge and invokes the actual generated stub; the final sm86 code retains CSR-bounded arithmetic, complete bulk and tail paths, and stores.
